interactiveFee.title: See what pay-as-you-go could cost.
interactiveFee.invalidOrders: Enter a whole number of orders, zero or more.
interactiveFee.invalidAmount: Enter a USD amount with up to two decimals.
interactiveFee.invalid: Enter valid, non-negative values to see an estimate.
interactiveFee.formula: For each AI-attributed order, the fee is {rate}% of its value, rounded to cents. The monthly total is capped at {cap}.
interactiveFee.noCheaper: At these inputs, pay-as-you-go has the lowest monthly price.
interactiveFee.qualification: This estimate uses your average order value. Actual fees are calculated per order, and account terms may differ. Compare plan features and limits before choosing.
